args.role: Qualify Canadian bookkeeping firms for the existing invoice subtotal reconciliation pilot. Verify workflow and inquiry route from first-party sources, reuse executed controls, and prepare one bounded private offer where supported. Track inquiry authorization, buyer response, order acceptance and verified settlement separately.

description: Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no newly interpreted signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Enkel’s HTTP 403 leaves that prospect’s workflow and inquiry route unverified. The next action tests LiveCA independently, using the existing invoice subtotal controls to limit unpaid preparation. A draft depends on readable first-party evidence of workflow fit and a published inquiry route. Sending requires exact-draft authorization, paid acceptance requires an eligible request and administrative action, and any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.
